name: Mittha
instructions: 1. Soak the Basmati rice in water for 30 minutes and drain.
2. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan and add whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon) to temper.
3. Add dry fruits and sauté until golden brown.
4. Add rice and stir gently to coat with ghee, then add water and a pinch of food color.
5. Cook on low heat until the rice is fluffy and water is absorbed.
6. Mix in sugar or jaggery, cover, and let it steam on very low flame until the sugar dissolves and infuses the rice.
7. Serve hot as a festive treat or as part of a Dham meal.
description: Mittha is a celebratory sweet rice dish often served during Himachali weddings and special occasions. It is a quintessential component of the traditional Himachali 'Dham' (community feast), symbolizing prosperity and auspicious beginnings.
